Reference / time/format

time/format#

Explicit, locale-free formatting and parsing.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

FormattedDate(
    origin: Date(year: 2026, month: 8, day: 11),
    pattern: "%d/%m/%Y",
).string(); // "11/08/2026"

FormattedDate(text: "11/08/2026", pattern: "%d/%m/%Y").date();

Description#

Explicit, locale-free formatting and parsing.

Directives are %Y, %m, %d, %H, %M, %S, %f and %%. Numeric fields have fixed widths 4/2/2/2/2/2/9. Date patterns reject time directives. Parsing requires every date field, and local-date-time parsing additionally requires hour, minute and second; nanoseconds default to zero. Every other character is a literal Unicode scalar. Month/day names and all locale-dependent directives are deliberately absent until an explicit locale value exists.
